preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.
The string s consists of lowercase English letters.
The number of queries q is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l_i <= r_i <= len(s) for l_i, r_i in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query (l_i, r_i), 1 ≤ l_i ≤ r_i ≤ |s|.

postconditions.description: The number of output values is equal to the number of queries q.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(value, int) for value in output)
postconditions.description: Each output value is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= value <= (r_i - l_i + 1) * (r_i - l_i + 2) // 2 for value, (l_i, r_i) in zip(output, queries))
postconditions.description: Each output value is the Ж-function of the corresponding substring s[l_i:r_i+1].
